runtimeMapping.normal: One ground/air victim; owner direct Arts at original Attack event; Fowlbeast tracked speed10 Arts projectile.
runtimeMapping.talent: Selected born stock3/4/5; owner and owned Fowlbeasts apply non-silenceable Machine-only phys/Arts output damage scale1.1/1.2.
runtimeMapping.skill1: AUTO at full SP; selected ASPD on owner and eligible owned Fowlbeasts; source Begin/Idle/Loop/End clips.
runtimeMapping.skill2: MANUAL; one immediate capped stock; eligible owned Fowlbeasts gain selected ATK, restart attack mode, prioritize heaviest and emit1s Sluggish projectiles.
runtimeMapping.summon: High-ground facing placement, cost8, slot1, cooldown10, no healing; source four stored cards plus ready card capped5; no recharge on removal; owner removal kills owned tokens.
runtimeMapping.animation: Two original owner facings; token uses native single skeleton with FaceSwitcher and original RGBA texture.

verificationLimits: Original C# frame ordering, modules, particles and audio remain unverified.
Native animation events and clip durations drive bounded simulation timing; 30Hz event scheduling and Begin/End transitions are not frame-for-frame certified.
Ready card plus four native stacked cards is modeled as a five-card stock cap; original compiled deck counter ordering is unverified.
Original token FaceSwitcher binding and bytes are retained; continuous native .15s facing interpolation is not reproduced.
Combat uses generic tracked projectile visuals and the shared Sluggish status rather than original particle/audio effects.
